scene: Digital graphic featuring text on a plain white background
description: The image displays a block of text presented in a black serif typeface against a solid white background. At the top is a bold title, followed by an excerpted paragraph regarding personal expectations and risk. The text concludes with an attribution indicating the author and book title at the bottom center-right.
ocr: The Danger of Flying Too Low

It’s far more dangerous to fly too low than too high, because it feels safe to fly low. We settle for low expectations and small dreams and guarantee ourselves less than we are capable of. By flying too low, we shortchange not only ourselves but also those who depend on us or might benefit from our work. We’re so obsessed about the risk of shining brightly that we’ve traded in everything that matters to avoid it.

Black serif font
Bold header text
Italicized book title
Text quote layout
